items.issue: Page has no h1 element — every page needs exactly one h1 as the main topic
items.suggestion: Add a single h1 that describes the main purpose of this page

items.issue: Heading jumps from h3 ("Новости") to h5 ("Заокружен проектот „Зелена хроматографија: Дел 3 – рационална трансформација на RP-HPLC методи – чекор напред кон одржливост во фармацевските анализи“") — levels should not skip
items.suggestion: Change h5 to h4 or add intermediate heading levels

issues: The page is missing an h1 heading, which is essential for defining the main topic and structure of the page.
There is an incorrect heading hierarchy where an h3 heading ("Новости") is immediately followed by h5 headings, skipping the h4 level.

Headings at the same level do not have comparable importance; individual news items and announcements are marked as h3, which is the same level as main section headings like "Новости" and "ОГЛАСНА ТАБЛА", creating a flat and confusing structure.

The heading "Отворениот повик за студенти за втората обука за претпрiемништво и иновации во рамки на Еразмус+ проектот EU2SE" appears twice as an h3, indicating potential redundancy or structural issues.
missingSections: A main heading for the statistics section (e.g., "Статистика" or "Клучни бројки") that lists student numbers and program counts.
A main heading for the primary navigation links (e.g., "Главна навигација" or "Навигација") that includes items like "Универзитет", "Настава", "Студенти", etc.
suggestions: Add a single h1 heading that clearly represents the main topic of the page, such as "Универзитет „Св. Кирил и Методиј“ во Скопје".
Correct the heading hierarchy by ensuring headings increase by only one level at a time (e.g., h3 should be followed by h4, not h5).
Restructure the page so that individual news items and announcements are nested under their respective section headings (e.g., "Новости" as h2, individual news items as h3 or h4).
Group related content, such as the statistics, under appropriate headings to improve content organization.
Review for and remove any duplicate headings to ensure unique and clear navigation points.
items.summary: The page has critical heading structure issues, including a missing h1, incorrect hierarchy jumps, and inconsistent heading levels, which severely impair navigation and understanding for screen reader users.

positives: Key navigation items are concise, though some contain jargon.
Important dates are clearly listed for announcements and calls.

improvements: Provide a plain language summary or an alternative version for complex news articles and announcements to cater to a broader audience.

Rewrite passive voice constructions into active voice where appropriate to make the content more direct and easier to follow.
items.summary: The content is highly specialized, targeting a university audience with extensive academic and technical terminology. It significantly exceeds the lower-secondary education level recommended by WCAG 3.1.5, lacking simplified alternatives for general comprehension.

issues: The main site link (likely the logo, given its common placement and link to the homepage) appears out of logical visual order, receiving focus after other header navigation links ('Поранешна веб страница', 'iKnow', 'iLearn'). Typically, the main site link/logo is one of the first elements in the header after a 'Skip to content' link.

The fifth link has empty text ('A: ""'). While not strictly a 2.4.3 issue, it impacts operability and predictability as a screen reader user would not know its purpose without additional context, making the focus order less predictable in terms of understanding what is being focused.
items.suggestion: Reorder the tab sequence so that the main site link (logo) receives focus earlier in the header, typically immediately after the 'Skip to content' link and before other primary navigation links. Additionally, ensure the main site link has meaningful accessible text (e.g., using `aria-label` or visually hidden text) to clearly describe its purpose to all users.
